findings.description: No key_policy is defined, so the key falls back to the default AWS-managed policy granting full access to the entire account (root) via IAM, which does not enforce least privilege for an audit-trail encryption key. Additionally, enable_key_rotation is not set (defaults to false), so automatic annual key rotation is disabled, weakening cryptographic hygiene for data protected by this key over time.
